Lombard Veterinary Hospital was established in June of 1959 to provide the animal population of greater DuPage County (Illinois) with a complete health care facility. We pride ourselves of being family owned and operated for 62 years. Today, we are a full-service, American Animal Hospital Association (AAHA) accredited veterinary hospital.

PLEASE NOTE: The content that we provide on this channel is for educational purposes only. We do not intend our content to be a substitute for medical advice, diagnosis, and or treatment. Please contact your pet's veterinarian if you have any questions of concerns about their wellbeing.
